name: 43021 · Galena, OH
findings: ZIP 43021 (Galena) has 41 nonprofit organizations. 11 of them (27%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 8 organizations.
Hobby and sports organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (38% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 43021 (Galena) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
27% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
